# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 1: The Big Question** (Week 1)

We start by playing with AI and asking the question that will run through the whole class: is this thing really like a human brain? You will write down your first answer. We will come back to it at the end of the semester.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Find AI in your everyday life
* Explain how AI is different from a normal computer program
* Explain how AI learns from examples and makes predictions
* Write your first answer to the big question

***

## Topics in This Unit

[**What Is AI?**](1.1_What_Is_AI.qmd)\
Sort things into AI and not AI, try to write a rule for “cat,” and play a drawing game against an AI.
